audit.why: Early levels favor Nami (no ranged answer to E-buffed poke), Alistar takes 4-6 once W-Q combo is online, Nami reclaims at 2+ items with team-wide peel — already reflected in whys[] and phases[].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no cooldown numbers despite naming Headbutt as the key tracked cooldown.
audit.why: Headbutt (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s and Pulverize (Q) is 14/13/12/11/10s — real numbers make the tracked-cooldown advice concrete instead of vague.
audit.corrected: Added rank-1/rank-5 cooldown figures for Headbutt and Pulverize.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interaction flag: Alistar sustains through chip damage via Triumphant Roar (P), and the itemization report line only says 'his duo's sustain' rather than naming his own passive heal.
audit.why: Triumphant Roar heals Alistar (and nearby allies) whenever he lands a stun/knockback or an enemy dies nearby — Grievous Wounds timing matters for denying that heal in extended trades.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Triumphant Roar directly and ties it to early anti-heal.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - Q Aqua Prison is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) is down 14s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — without it, Pulverize (Q, 14-10s) can't finish the combo, so track it before you step up. - Your Q Aqua Prison is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: The moment he commits Trample (E) stacks for the bonus-damage stun, empower your carry with E — the slow punishes his follow-through before his auto lands.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: If he burns Flash to force Headbutt-Pulverize, he has no escape left — commit through Unbreakable Will's reduction rather than trading the window evenly.

edits.before: Carry through conversion — every landed bubble is a won exchange; your job is the spacing that lands them.
edits.after: Carry through conversion — punish Trample stacks or a whiffed Headbutt with a landed bubble; spacing wins the exchange.
